death.attack.skyabyss.heat_burst.player: %1$s was burned by the heat of %2$s
death.attack.skyabyss.engulfed.player: %1$s was pushed into the embers by %2$s
__ember.B: body and hub (message.skyabyss.ember.back.*, whisper.*, gui.skyabyss.ember_heat.*, sign.skyabyss.lore_ember_*)
message.skyabyss.ember.back.stone_ready: Deep in the kindle stone, a fire stirs.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.east_silent: The kindle stone is silent. The smith still stands at the forge.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.south_silent: The kindle stone is silent. The hearth fire is still thin.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.shortcut_ope: The floor by the stone begins to glow like embers.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.all_rung: Three stones have rung. The fire in the great forge begins to waver.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.gate_open: The forge fire died. The cooled hearth floor opens downward.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.shortcut: The ember floor carried you back to the hall.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.trials_renew: The fires inside the body have rekindled.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.sleeping_wes: Tonight the western ash road lies cold and asleep.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.sleeping_eas: Tonight the eastern forge already burns.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.sleeping_sou: Tonight the southern hearth already glows.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.peaceful: The titan does not wake. The throat is closed.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.gave_up: The cold fire pushed you back onto the tongue.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.campfire_hin: The blue fire is the ash folk's cold fire. Sneak and touch it to return to the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.heat.scorching: You are starting to scorch. Cool down on an ash pool
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.mouth: The tongue is hot. Deep in the throat, red light swells with each breath.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.throat: Heat builds near lava and fades on ash. Before you scorch, stand on a grey ash pool.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.hub: Under the ribs stands the great forge of the ash folk. Its fire has never gone out.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.ash: Standing on a grey ash pool draws the heat out of you.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.west: The ash road. Scatter ash and the lava lake cools into crust.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.east: The forge hall. Strike when the colour is right.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.south: The hearth keepers. Do not let the fire die. The bursts of heat burn foes too.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.well: The forge heat rises up the shaft. You warm as you climb.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.crater: From the crater you see the ash plain and the night sky. Far below, the forge still burns.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.back: The seams of the back scales glow like embers.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.heart: Beyond the wall, something beats slowly.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.arrived: It is hot. The ash underfoot is warm, like breath.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.leaving: Down the ash steps, the night air was cold.
